notes.title: Additional Hit-Box Fix September 6th
notes.content:
Hello!

Thanks again for your feedback, we have just fixed another bug regarding hit-box selection.

There was an issue specifically with animated characters, due to the way their "sprites" constantly change to animate. There should no longer be tooltip issues with selecting characters like the Captain.

Michael

notes.title: Fixed Crates!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Let us know if you face anymore problems!

LVGameDev

notes.title: Our New Game! Escape: The Endless Dogwatch
notes.content:
[h2]An Adventure Like No Other[/h2]

This autumn we'll be releasing a new point and click adventure game set on a creepy ship.

January, 1928. The SS Carolina is lost deep in the ocean. There's a deadly chill outside. The captain is hiding something from you. By night 2 you're attacked and the crew is missing! It's a nightmare!

You play as 2nd Officer Walton. Explore the ship, use items, find the crew, and try to survive! You must get back to land and not let the ship sink.

[h2]Let Us Know What You Think![/h2]

Check out our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066300/Escape_The_Endless_Dogwatch/]store page[/url]!

Feel free to speculate in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066300/Escape_The_Endless_Dogwatch/]forums[/url] what you would like or expect to see in the game, and if you have any interest in testing in the near future.

Please also give us feedback on our screenshots and trailer!

Finally, add this game to your wishlist for future updates!

PS. Be kind to everyone!
